openings.claim: Replace dependence on magnetic attraction with removable positive boundaries: slot-mounted steel strips contact nonworking plate margins, while pivoting strip clamps prevent lift. This is a fabrication-and-test candidate, not demonstrated retention.
openings.delta: The carrier becomes drilled steel strips attached through existing carriage slots with M4 bolts. Reserve two strips for releasable top clamps and two for lateral/longitudinal stops; cork pads protect contacted surfaces. Loosen and swing the clamps using their long strip ends, lift by unmarked margins, and return against the stops. The nearest rival is the same clamp arrangement relying on cork friction with the stop strips disengaged.
openings.prediction: If positive stops are responsible, the engaged-stop configuration should show less displacement than the friction-only rival, particularly with the spare plate. Both configurations may instead pass because clamp friction suffices; that result does not establish a stop benefit. Plate-strength differences need not affect mechanical boundaries, but glove handling may defeat the sixty-second service target.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, measure whether accessible slots accept M4 attachments and whether all four strips can capture the plate outside both the exposed working edge and the full marked stroke clearance. Reject the layout if these conditions fail. Use at most two configurations and three twenty-stroke runs each: original plate once, spare twice, with the final run using the spare. Mark two nonworking reference points; measure their displacement after each run to expose translation or rotation. Perform three timed removal/return checks per configuration wearing the supplied gloves. Record edge contact and return position. A pass requires every tested displacement within 1 mm and each service check within sixty seconds. Excess stop clearance, strip flexure, bolt loosening, lift escape or inaccessible clamp ends defeat the candidate.
assumptions: Slot dimensions, available margin geometry, strip stiffness and clamp accessibility are unprovided and indispensable.
Fabrication fits eighty minutes and testing twenty minutes only if assembly and glove operation are sufficiently quick; verify rather than assume.

assessment: One opening. It preserves all hard constraints by rejecting incompatible geometry. No magnetic-force result establishes stroke retention, and the proposed mechanical behavior remains unmeasured.
